records.product_name: Drinking Water (Purified) sold through vending machine
records.exact_finished_product_boundary: A vending-machine purified water product is not automatically packaged drinking water.
records.positive_documentary_evidence_to_obtain: Confirm applicable finished dispensing-water legal category, point-of-sale collection route, water treatment controls, applicable IS/standards, sampling location and marketing form.
records.prohibited_source_article_transfer: Packaged drinking water metals and pesticide MRLs cannot be silently assigned to dispensed drinking water.

records.exact_finished_product_boundary: Coffee-chicory mixture is not necessarily the named coffee or dried chicory commodity.
records.positive_documentary_evidence_to_obtain: Obtain exact coffee:chicory ratio, whether roasted coffee beans or chicory were processed into extract/powder, marketed finished form and matching statutory source article.
records.prohibited_source_article_transfer: Copper article for coffee beans or dried chicory and ochratoxin A article for coffee cannot transfer to the mixture by label alone.

records.exact_finished_product_boundary: Children's formulated supplement is not automatically infant formula or infant food.
records.positive_documentary_evidence_to_obtain: Document intended population and age, composition, infant-food statutory status, product form and relevant special nutrition regulations.
records.prohibited_source_article_transfer: Infant formula lead/aflatoxin-M1 and infant milk substitute provisions cannot apply solely because children consume it.

records.exact_finished_product_boundary: The frozen finished fruit must not inherit the whole fresh fruit/juice MRL simply through its input.
records.positive_documentary_evidence_to_obtain: Document each botanical fruit, peeled/cut/blanched/individually frozen processing, any additional ingredients and frozen market form; establish finished regulatory article.
records.prohibited_source_article_transfer: Raw whole fruit, fruit juice and canned-fruit metal or pesticide articles require separate applicability evidence.

records.exact_finished_product_boundary: Catechu edible extract differs from raw plant crop and unrelated food colours.
records.positive_documentary_evidence_to_obtain: Confirm botanical source, extraction/purification, powder or paste form and exact finished FSSR 2.11.2 commodity/matrix.
records.prohibited_source_article_transfer: No automatic attribution from food colouring, dried herbs, spices, or generally undefined chemicals.

records.exact_finished_product_boundary: Fruit cheese is a separate standardized confection-like fruit preparation, not automatically jam, jelly or pulp.
records.positive_documentary_evidence_to_obtain: Verify finished product gel structure, permitted FSSR fruit-cheese formulation and marketing identity; obtain legal basis if claiming the jam/pulp contaminant article.
records.prohibited_source_article_transfer: Jam/jelly lead, fruit pulp copper/arsenic and canned-pulp tin cannot be borrowed by similarity.

records.exact_finished_product_boundary: Processed seedless tamarind is not automatically fresh fruit, fruit pulp or juice.
records.positive_documentary_evidence_to_obtain: Establish removal/drying/preservation processing, whole tamarind versus paste and any added preservatives before choosing exact finished article.
records.prohibited_source_article_transfer: Fresh fruit or generic fruit-pulp metal limits and raw-commodity pesticide MRLs do not transfer automatically.

records.exact_finished_product_boundary: Coconut milk powder is neither dairy milk powder nor coconut oil.
records.positive_documentary_evidence_to_obtain: Document actual coconut extract process, moisture/fat basis, additives and whether product is standardized coconut milk powder.
records.prohibited_source_article_transfer: Aflatoxin M1 dairy milk powder rows, lead milk article and coconut oil metals cannot be copied over.

records.exact_finished_product_boundary: Frozen vegetables are neither canned vegetables nor dehydrated vegetables.
records.positive_documentary_evidence_to_obtain: Verify true frozen product identity, source vegetables, recipe, blanching and any composite ingredients; retain separate finished-product scope.
records.prohibited_source_article_transfer: Lead canned-vegetable and dried/dehydrated vegetables articles are not general frozen-vegetable limits.

records.exact_finished_product_boundary: Raw/roasted cocoa beans differ legally and analytically from defatted cocoa powder.
records.positive_documentary_evidence_to_obtain: Check raw/roasted bean identity, shell status and stage at sale; establish any bean-specific official row and analytical basis.
records.prohibited_source_article_transfer: Lead cocoa powder on dry fat-free substance basis and powder copper/arsenic cannot be assigned to beans.

records.product_name: Dry Mixtures of Cocoa and Sugars
records.exact_finished_product_boundary: Dry cocoa-and-sugar mixture is not identical to standalone cocoa powder, sugar or hard-boiled confectionery.
records.positive_documentary_evidence_to_obtain: Verify actual standardized dry-mixture ingredients, cocoa solids/fat basis, product stage, and the finished article wording in CTR.
records.prohibited_source_article_transfer: Cocoa powder metal values, high-ash sugar lead and HBC metal limits cannot be inherited automatically.

records.product_name: Cocoa mass or Cocoa/Chocolate Liquor and Cocoa Cake
records.exact_finished_product_boundary: Cocoa mass/liquor and cocoa cake contain different residual cocoa butter from cocoa powder.
records.positive_documentary_evidence_to_obtain: Obtain exact cocoa liquor/cake processing stage, fat content, defatting and sale identity; confirm article-specific fat-free analytical basis before matching.
records.prohibited_source_article_transfer: Do not substitute cocoa-powder lead/copper analytical basis for high-fat cocoa mass or intermediate cake.

records.exact_finished_product_boundary: Quinoa is expressly excluded from some cereal-grain metal articles.
records.positive_documentary_evidence_to_obtain: Identify quinoa as sold, cleaned/hulled/flaked processing and its legal category; confirm each proposed CTR row individually.
records.prohibited_source_article_transfer: The lead and cadmium cereal-grain row explicitly excluding quinoa cannot be transferred from wheat/rice.

records.exact_finished_product_boundary: Chia seeds are not automatically a legally listed oilseed or generic cereal grain.
records.positive_documentary_evidence_to_obtain: Verify Salvia hispanica identity, processing, sale as edible whole chia or extraction feedstock and exact named oilseed article applicability.
records.prohibited_source_article_transfer: Do not borrow unrelated cereal metal limits or unspecified oilseed/pesticide commodity MRLs.

records.exact_finished_product_boundary: Carob powder is not cocoa powder simply because both are brown flavour ingredients.
records.positive_documentary_evidence_to_obtain: Verify Ceratonia siliqua origin, drying/milling, powder composition and legal classification under FSSR 2.11.7.
records.prohibited_source_article_transfer: Cocoa powder lead and copper limits, cocoa mass rules and generic coffee rules are not carob rules.

records.exact_finished_product_boundary: Arrowroot flour is a distinct root-starch product, not cassava/manihot/tapioca.
records.positive_documentary_evidence_to_obtain: Confirm Maranta arundinacea or other source, refined starch versus milled root and actual standard 2.4.14 identity.
records.prohibited_source_article_transfer: Hydrocyanic acid article expressly listing sago, cassava, tapioca and manihot does not list arrowroot.

records.exact_finished_product_boundary: Singhare ka atta is water-chestnut flour, not a cereal or cassava flour.
records.positive_documentary_evidence_to_obtain: Confirm Trapa species, processing, whole seed/milled flour basis and the specific standardized water-chestnut clause.
records.prohibited_source_article_transfer: Do not inherit cassava/tapioca HCN provision or pesticide MRLs for milled cereal grains without source equivalence.

records.exact_finished_product_boundary: Animal casings are a processed anatomical article, not unspecified muscle meat or raw edible offal.
records.positive_documentary_evidence_to_obtain: Document species, intestinal tissue, cleaned/salted/dried process, intended use and edible veterinary-residue basis.
records.prohibited_source_article_transfer: Raw muscle/tissue veterinary MRLs and meat heavy-metal values cannot automatically be used for processed casings.

records.exact_finished_product_boundary: Dried egg powder is not the as-laid whole egg analytical matrix.
records.positive_documentary_evidence_to_obtain: Confirm species, whole/yolk/white egg ingredient, shell removal, drying/concentration factor and edible finished powder basis.
records.prohibited_source_article_transfer: Raw egg veterinary tolerance and fresh egg commodity MRLs cannot transfer without explicit processed-egg applicability.

records.exact_finished_product_boundary: Pickled eggs are acidified/cured finished eggs rather than fresh shell-free eggs.
records.positive_documentary_evidence_to_obtain: Document egg species, shell removal, pickle medium, acidification process, moisture and final edible matrix.
records.prohibited_source_article_transfer: Raw eggs residue and unprocessed animal product rules require named processed-pickled egg legal basis.

records.exact_finished_product_boundary: FSSR 2.8.7 dried glucose syrup has sulphated ash not above 1%.
records.positive_documentary_evidence_to_obtain: Verify the legal dried-glucose-syrup standard, actual sulphated ash method and exact marketed powder.
records.prohibited_source_article_transfer: Lead row expressly requiring starch conversion products with sulphated ash over 1% is not met by compliant dried glucose syrup.
prior_named_articles_review_only: All types of sugars, sugar syrup, invert sugar and direct consumption coloured sugars with sulphated ash content exceeding 1.0 percent

records.exact_finished_product_boundary: Edible lactose is a purified milk-derived sugar, not liquid milk.
records.positive_documentary_evidence_to_obtain: Establish lactose purity/crystal form and edible lactose 2.1.20 category; examine whether any lactose-specific metal article exists.
records.prohibited_source_article_transfer: Lead for liquid milk and milk powder aflatoxin M1 criteria cannot transfer to purified lactose.

records.exact_finished_product_boundary: Cube sugar standard specifies total ash not exceeding 0.03%.
records.positive_documentary_evidence_to_obtain: Document true FSSR cube sugar 2.8.1(5) identity, sulphated versus total ash analytical basis and whether any specific refined-sugar article applies.
records.prohibited_source_article_transfer: The high-sulphated-ash greater-than-1% lead article is not supported by this cube sugar standard.
prior_named_articles_review_only: All types of sugars, sugar syrup, invert sugar and direct consumption coloured sugars with sulphated ash content exceeding 1.0 percent

records.exact_finished_product_boundary: Misri's total ash criterion does not establish sulphated ash above 1%.
records.positive_documentary_evidence_to_obtain: Document FSSR 2.8.2 misri identity, raw sugar source, total ash and any sulphated ash result where legally relevant.
records.prohibited_source_article_transfer: Do not treat total ash max 0.4% as a sulphated-ash greater-than-1% trigger or Misri as refined sugar by analogy.
prior_named_articles_review_only: All types of sugars, sugar syrup, invert sugar and direct consumption coloured sugars with sulphated ash content exceeding 1.0 percent

records.product_name: Polyols permitted under Appendix-A of FSS(FPS&FA) Regulations,2011 excluding those already standardized
records.exact_finished_product_boundary: The broad FoSCoS polyols category contains different chemical substances.
records.positive_documentary_evidence_to_obtain: Identify exact molecular compound, purity/grade, CAS where applicable and any chemical-specific FSSAI metal article.
records.prohibited_source_article_transfer: Sorbitol or other named polyol metal entries cannot apply to all unspecified polyols.

records.exact_finished_product_boundary: Salt substitutes are not automatically sodium chloride food-grade salt.
records.positive_documentary_evidence_to_obtain: Get precise potassium/sodium/magnesium composition, regulated market category and specific constituent contaminant article.
records.prohibited_source_article_transfer: Food-grade salt lead and iron-fortified common salt rows cannot be applied by name resemblance.

records.exact_finished_product_boundary: Colouring foods can be intrinsically coloured food concentrates rather than synthetic colour preparations.
records.positive_documentary_evidence_to_obtain: Establish material extraction process, whether it is a food ingredient or legal colour additive, concentration/dry colouring basis and FSSR identity.
records.prohibited_source_article_transfer: Synthetic food colour or colouring matter lead/copper/arsenic rows require matching regulated colour class.

records.exact_finished_product_boundary: Trehalose is a disaccharide with its own product standard, not sucrose, dextrose or lactose.
records.positive_documentary_evidence_to_obtain: Confirm trehalose 3.3.4 manufacturing/purity and the explicitly named food ingredient metal article, if any.
records.prohibited_source_article_transfer: No unverified transfer from refined sugar, anhydrous dextrose or high-ash syrup rows.

records.exact_finished_product_boundary: Sajji Khar is a traditional alkaline salt mixture not necessarily pure sodium hydroxide.
records.positive_documentary_evidence_to_obtain: Identify ingredient mineral/alkali composition, food-use status, purity source and specific FSSAI contaminant article.
records.prohibited_source_article_transfer: Pure sodium hydroxide, sodium carbonate or regular salt articles are not automatically the mixed Sajji Khar article.

records.product_name: Additives permitted under Appendix-A of FSS (FPS&FA) Regulations, 2011 and other food safety standards regulations excluding those already standardized and additives of Nutraceutical Regulations
records.exact_finished_product_boundary: A broad Appendix A additives route has no single chemical contaminant identity.
records.positive_documentary_evidence_to_obtain: Select the precise permitted additive, standardized definition and corresponding individual CTR/FSSR limit, not the category umbrella.
records.prohibited_source_article_transfer: Specific food dye, gum, preservative or antioxidant metal limits are not transferable to all additives.

records.product_name: Additives VA-VF of Nutraceutical Regulations excluding those already standardised
records.exact_finished_product_boundary: Nutraceutical VA–VF permitted additive groups contain chemically different compounds.
records.positive_documentary_evidence_to_obtain: Record exact authorized nutraceutical additive, intended use, standard and the applicable substance-specific source row.
records.prohibited_source_article_transfer: An additive grouping does not establish the impurity specifications for an unspecified additive.

records.product_name: Permitted enzymes and their preparations excluding those already listed under Processing Aids and Nutraceutical Regulations
records.exact_finished_product_boundary: Enzyme preparations must be identified by enzyme, production organism and carrier.
records.positive_documentary_evidence_to_obtain: Capture enzyme designation, microorganism/animal/plant source, processing-aid regulatory route and carrier formulation.
records.prohibited_source_article_transfer: Enzyme preparations cannot automatically inherit metals for unrelated stabilizers, animal tissues or botanical raw materials.

records.product_name: Ingredients listed under Schedule IV, Schedule VI and Schedule VIII of Nutraceutical Regulations
records.exact_finished_product_boundary: Ingredients under multiple nutraceutical Schedules are heterogeneous.
records.positive_documentary_evidence_to_obtain: Establish Schedule IV/VI/VIII item, botanical or chemical identity, extract ratio and source-specific legal limits.
records.prohibited_source_article_transfer: No universal herb/spice/pulse MRL may be assigned to the entire regulatory schedule category.

records.exact_finished_product_boundary: A premix combines ingredients with different active chemical and contaminant requirements.
records.positive_documentary_evidence_to_obtain: Document actual formula, product claim and intended use, ingredient-specific legal articles, finished composite regulatory category.
records.prohibited_source_article_transfer: An arbitrary parent functional ingredient MRL cannot stand in for the finished premix legal limit.

records.product_name: Cow or Buffalo Colostrum and Colostrum Products
records.exact_finished_product_boundary: Bovine colostrum is physiologically and compositionally different from normal liquid milk.
records.positive_documentary_evidence_to_obtain: Confirm cow/buffalo colostrum versus concentrated/powder product, FSSR 2.1.23, IgG method and finished matrix before selecting contaminant articles.
records.prohibited_source_article_transfer: Milk liquid lead or aflatoxin M1 milk powder article cannot transfer to colostrum without exact legal basis.

records.exact_finished_product_boundary: Royal jelly is a bee secretion and is not honey or beeswax.
records.positive_documentary_evidence_to_obtain: Verify fresh/freeze-dried royal jelly identity, processing and source-specific CTR article; identify analytical basis.
records.prohibited_source_article_transfer: Honey quality/contaminant values and beeswax lead article cannot be used for royal jelly.

records.exact_finished_product_boundary: Edible silver leaf is a metallic food-decoration article, not a dye or metallic contaminant result by identity.
records.positive_documentary_evidence_to_obtain: Establish lawful FSSR 2.11.4 silver purity and manufacturing requirements, alternative metal contamination criteria and applicable analytical method.
records.prohibited_source_article_transfer: Food colour limits, metallic silver percentage, lead-in-food fallback and food contact metals are distinct questions.

records.exact_finished_product_boundary: Narikela Ksheerika cannot be equated to liquid milk from the name alone.
records.positive_documentary_evidence_to_obtain: Obtain official Ayurveda Aahara recipe, actual coconut and milk ingredients, processing, finished moisture and legal category.
records.prohibited_source_article_transfer: Liquid milk lead/aflatoxin M1 and coconut oil metals cannot be inherited merely from ingredient names.

records.exact_finished_product_boundary: Ksheerapaka may include milk but the finished medicinal food formulation is not liquid milk.
records.positive_documentary_evidence_to_obtain: Document exact official Ayurveda recipe, dairy proportion and other ingredients, thermal concentration and marketed category.
records.prohibited_source_article_transfer: Milk liquid, dried milk and cereal ingredient source rows need explicit finished-form evidence.

records.exact_finished_product_boundary: Soluble fibre dextrin is chemically processed carbohydrate, not whole grain or ordinary flour.
records.positive_documentary_evidence_to_obtain: Check resistant/soluble dextrin origin, 2.11.8 manufacture and purification, food additive/ingredient category and actual specification.
records.prohibited_source_article_transfer: Wheat grain metal/pesticide rows and high-ash starch-conversion product articles cannot be copied without proof.
